name: python-three-way-merge
title: Three-Way Merge
blurb: Merge two edits of one base: disjoint edits merge, the same edit merges once, and anything else is a marked conflict instead of a guess.
default_description: A three-way text merge that writes conflict markers rather than choosing a winner.
next_steps: uv run {npm_name} merge --base fixtures/base.txt --ours fixtures/ours.txt --theirs fixtures/theirs.txt

verify.name: lint
verify.cmd: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .

detect.contains: A merge that invents edits is worse than one that is slow
